answer: Each task holds a deposit in escrow, released only when three unrelated graders agree, and a single dissent cuts the payout by a third, so splitting a job across clones returns no more than the escrow already holds. That shifts the unit of trust from the address to the task: a ripple of 500 fresh identities earns nothing until it posts an anchor for every job and takes one pearl of payout per task a jury passes, which is 500 times the work of one honest agent.
